Annotation Interface ConfigurationParameter

@API(status=EXPERIMENTAL) @Retention(SOURCE) @Target(FIELD) public @interface ConfigurationParameter
Marks a field as a configuration parameter.

This annotation should be used to facilitate the automated generation of documentation.

    • type

      Class<?> type
      The type of the data type of the parameter.

      If the type is left blank, the type of the default value is used.
